---
title: "Evaluating output"
description: "Output that seems to work still needs a rigorous check."
---

Understanding comes before prediction [@del2024prediction; @messeri2024artificial]. An AI tool can produce code that runs, a plot that looks right, or a summary that reads well. Before any of it reaches a talk or a paper, someone has to check it rigorously.

## Open questions

- What counts as a sufficient check for AI-generated code, analysis, and text?
- How do we avoid the illusion of understanding a result because the explanation sounds convincing?
- Which checks can be automated, and which need a person who knows the chemistry?
- How do we document what was checked, and by whom?
